Hello community,

Quick reminder that the Java ILP Community Call is tomorrow (9/25/2019) at 5pm UTC (10am PST).

This call is open to anyone who would like to discuss ILP on the Java platform, but will also include discussion around the Quilt library.

Please respond to this post if you would like to add more items to discuss! Here’s the current agenda:

Agenda

  1. Introductions
  2. Discuss Quilt v1.0 (issues, timeline, artifacts, etc).
  3. Discuss open Quilt issues & PRs
  4. Discuss Quilt Roadmap
  5. Q&A, misc issues
